I’m **Nattamon (ZOey) Wattanapenpaiboon**, a Senior Bank Examiner at the Bank of Thailand (BOT). I am currently sponsored by BOT to pursue a Master of Business Analytics at Monash University, with the goal of strengthening analytical capability to support financial supervision and risk assessment to ensure the stability and resilience of Thailand’s banking sector.

This website is part of my learning journey at Monash, created for *ETC5523: Communicating with Data*. It showcases how I apply analytical and communication skills to new domains — including public health modelling — by translating complex research into stories for a general audience.
